fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META) operates two segments: Family of Apps and Reality Labs, offering social platforms including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, and XR products such as Meta Quest and AI glasses.
fields.summary_ko.1: Collaborates with Microsoft, NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, and OpenAI, headquartered in Menlo Park, California as social media and metaverse company.
